seo_description: VyuhaAero Systems is an Indian aerospace and autonomous-systems venture from Chennai, developing indigenous aerial platforms and distributed sensing architectures for civilian and defence applications.

hero.headline: India's next frontier
hero.intro: We are an Indian deep-tech venture developing indigenous aerial platforms and the sensing, communications and navigation systems that make them useful, for civilian and defence applications.

statement.body: The nature of aerial operations has changed. Coverage has to be wider, systems have to be more resilient, and the capability behind them has to be built here. That is the work we have chosen.

mission.label: Who we are
mission.title: Made in India.
paragraphs: VyuhaAero Systems is incubated at V-NEST, VIT Chennai, and founded by engineering students working across aerospace, electronics, autonomy and intelligent systems.

We are not building a drone and looking for a use case. We are building towards a distributed aerial sensing system, and engineering the aerial nodes it needs. Our work is at an early stage, and we describe it honestly: through experimentation, measurement, iteration and disciplined engineering.

film.label: The film
film.title: Many, moving as one.
film.caption: Vyuha (n.), Sanskrit: a formation. Our launch film sets out the problem we are working on and the direction we are taking.

careers.label: Join us
careers.title: Choose the hard way
careers.body: We are a small team with a long horizon. If you want to work on aerial platforms, RF and sensing, networked autonomy or embedded systems, and you value evidence over opinion, write to us with what you have built.
